form.label: MCP Server
form.description: See which MCP servers ran and where they connected, track tool-call volume over time, and catch connection, auth and TLS problems.

search.query: | metadata type=hosts index=claude | sort host | fields host

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ sourcetype=claude:desktop:mcp | rex field=source "mcp-server-(?<sv_file>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)\.log$" | rex field=_raw "\[(?:info|error|warn)\]\s+\[(?<sv_msg>[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)\]" | rex field=_raw "^\S+\s+\[(?<sv_msg2>[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)\]\s+\[(?:info|error|warn)\]" | eval server=coalesce(sv_file, sv_msg, sv_msg2, "unknown") | eval kind=case( match(_raw, "method=\"tools/call\""), "tools_call", match(_raw, "method=\"initialize\""), "initialize", match(_raw, "Connecting to remote server"), "connect", match(_raw, "NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED"), "tls_insecure", match(_raw, "Server disconnected") OR match(_raw, "transport closed"), "disconnect", match(_raw, "ENOENT") OR match(_raw, "spawn "), "spawn_fail", match(_raw, "[Oo]auth") OR match(_raw, "401") OR match(_raw, "403") OR match(_raw, "[Uu]nauthorized") OR match(_raw, "[Ff]orbidden") OR match(_raw, "invalid_token") OR match(_raw, "access denied"), "auth_error", true(), "other") | where kind!="other" | eval sec=floor(_time) | dedup sec host kind server
| where kind="connect" | rex field=_raw "Connecting to remote server:\s*(?<endpoint>\S+)" | stats dc(endpoint)
| where kind="connect" | timechart span=1h count by server

panel.title: Tool calls over time by server

search.query: | where kind="tools_call" | timechart span=1h count by server

panel.title: MCP servers: activity, endpoints and timing

search.query: | rex field=_raw "Connecting to remote server:\s*(?<endpoint>\S+)" | rex field=endpoint "https?://(?<dest>[^/:]+)" | stats count as events sum(eval(if(kind="tools_call",1,0))) as tool_calls sum(eval(if(kind="initialize",1,0))) as inits sum(eval(if(kind="connect",1,0))) as remote_connects sum(eval(if(kind="disconnect",1,0))) as disconnects sum(eval(if(kind="tls_insecure",1,0))) as tls_disabled values(dest) as dest_hosts values(endpoint) as endpoints dc(host) as hosts min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by server | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%m-%d %H:%M"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%m-%d %H:%M") | table server hosts inits remote_connects tool_calls disconnects tls_disabled dest_hosts endpoints first_seen last_seen | sort - tool_calls

| where kind="connect" | rex field=_raw "Connecting to remote server:\s*(?<endpoint>\S+)" | rex field=endpoint "https?://(?<dest>[^/:]+)(?::(?<port>\d+))?" | stats count as connects values(server) as servers dc(host) as hosts min(_time) as first max(_time) as last by endpoint dest port | eval first=strftime(first, "%m-%d %H:%M"), last=strftime(last, "%m-%d %H:%M") | table endpoint dest port servers hosts connects first last | sort - connects

| where kind IN ("disconnect","spawn_fail","auth_error","tls_insecure") | eval detail=replace(replace(replace(_raw, "\s+", " "), "^\S+ \S+ ", ""), "^(\[[^\]]+\]\s*)+", "") | eval detail=substr(detail, 1, 200) | eval _epoch=_time | table _time host server kind detail _epoch | sort - _time | head 100
